item.title: uYouEnhanced v21.14.4
item.description:
Current YouTube IPA: "21.14.4" Current uYou Version: "3.0.5 (Unofficial)"
RELEASE 21.14.4 - 3.0.5: (2026-08-22)
• Updated for YouTube 21.14.4 • uYou Downloads fixed for modern YouTube (fixes infinite "Downloading...") • Fixed iSponsorBlock startup crash on 21.x • App Icons now actually work + fresh grid picker UI • Notifications Tab is now reorderable • iPad & landscape UI fixes across all custom menus • uYou rebranded to 3.0.5 (Unofficial build)
